name: S Kano ~Chotto S na Kanojo wa Suki Desu ka?~
original_name: エスカノ ～ちょっとSな彼女は好きですか?～
source:
Kosuke and Sayuri have been dating for about a year. They get along well and have sex frequently, but lately it's started to feel a bit stale. One day, they visit the usual love hotel and use their accumulated points to enter a raffle. The prize? A "starter S&M set" of adult toys.

"Hey, we won this - be a shame not to use it, right?"

He nods at Sayuri's casual suggestion, and they decide to give the toys a try. And so begins their private journey into S&M play.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/21309]official site[/url]]
translation:
康介与小百合交往已近一年。两人感情很好，也经常做爱，只是近来渐渐有些缺乏新鲜感。一天，他们像往常一样来到情侣酒店，用积攒的点数参加抽奖。奖品竟是一套“SM入门套装”成人玩具。

“喂，既然都抽中了，不用岂不是太可惜了？”

面对小百合随口提出的建议，他点头答应，两人决定试试这些玩具。就这样，只属于两人的SM游戏之旅开始了。
